details: Federal Reserve Chair Warsh's hawkish remarks at the Jackson Hole symposium, citing persistent inflation concerns, have impacted cryptocurrency market sentiment. Following these comments, spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded over $201 million in net daily redemptions on Friday, August 28, ending a nine-day streak of inflows. This shift suggests a cautious market outlook as investors consider the implications of potentially tighter monetary policy.
title: Hawkish Fed Tone Hits Crypto, Bitcoin ETFs See Outflows

details: Despite a broader market dip that saw Ethereum (ETH) trading around $2,436 on August 29, U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs have maintained strong institutional interest. They recorded inflows of $102.18 million on August 28, marking the tenth consecutive day of net inflows, with aggregate consumption reaching approximately $1.52 billion during this period. BlackRock's ETHA and ETHB funds were among the top receivers.
title: Ethereum ETFs Continue Inflows Despite Market Weakness

details: Bitcoin's price is consolidating around $77,570 after a recent rally, with on-chain data indicating a divergence in holder behavior: larger wallets are accumulating, while smaller holders are distributing. Analysts point to $73,880 as a crucial support level. If Bitcoin maintains this support and breaks above the $81,000–$84,000 resistance, a move towards the $100,000 psychological and technical target could be in sight.
title: Bitcoin Whales Accumulate, $73K Support Holds Amid $100K Target Hopes

details: The altcoin market showed a mixed performance this week. Solana (SOL) led the gains, buoyed by an announcement from Charles Schwab to list the digital asset alongside AVAX and LINK. In contrast, XRP and Dogecoin (DOGE), which were strong performers previously, experienced significant declines of approximately 7%. The overall crypto market capitalization ended flat at $2.73 trillion after volatile swings.
title: Altcoins Diverge: Solana Gains on Schwab News, XRP & DOGE Fall
